Stonehill Founder’s Day Run
:
Raadiant Sports is honored to organize in the beautiful campus of Stonehill International School, a running event for all age groups with choice of distances and also ensure the corporate professionals get to meet and bond with their colleagues around a sporting event.
       Stonehill Founder’s Day Run event comprises of 5K,10K and Half Marathon distances for runners looking to run in individual categories and for the Corporate Professionals we have 4 x 5 Kms Corporate Relay in Men, Women and Mixed categories. But Individuals not planning to run longer distances can form team of 4 members and as a team participate in Open 4 x 5 Kms Relay by making sure of the 4 members atleast 1 is from opposite gender. People who are beginners to running or want to be a part of the event can participate in the 5 Kms Run / Walk Non - Competitive category.

name: BeAthlit Lake Run - September 2026 Edition
description:
What is Lake Run?
Lake Run is BeAthlit's signature multi-event running series, designed around Bengaluru's most beautiful water bodies. Each edition takes place at a different lake — giving runners a fresh experience, a new trail, and a new story every time.
More than just a run, it's a series. A journey. Every event you complete counts toward an annual tally — and hitting 5 in a year earns you the most coveted medal in the series: Legends of Lake composite medal.
BeAthlit Monthly Lake Runs
We are bringing Lake Runs in a new format to make it easy for everyone to participate and appreciate the lakes. As lake authorities don’t allow any structure inside or near the lakes, this will resemble a community run.
What's the new format:
Choose a lake at which you want to run
Register
Report at the lake and collect your t-shirt on the day of the run between 7 am to 9 am (as lakes close by 10 am)
Run on your own, with family or with friends. Record the run on any of the fitness apps like Strava, Garmin, Google Fit, Nike Run Club, RunKeeper, etc
Show the proof of your run to our team, collect the medals, and celebrate.
Runners who finish 5 lake runs till Dec 2026 will earn a composite medal called 
“Legend of Lakes”
.
How It Works
Register for the event
Choose your preferred lake
Arrive at the lake entrance between 6 AM - 9 AM
Report to our team and collect your T-shirt
Complete your 1.6K / 3K / 5K /10k run
Track your run using Strava
For kids running with an accompanying adult, the adult’s Strava activity will be considered valid
Show your activity to our team at the lake
Collect your Medal
Important Guidelines
Complete your run at the lake you select during registration from 6 AM- 9:30 AM.
Strava activity is required for medal eligibility
Distance must be clearly visible in your activity
No Bibs will be provided
No hydration or on-route support will be available
Our team will be present at each lake entrance for verification and distribution

name: Sprint Adventure Race
description:
Hello Everyone,
Want to test your TEAM SPIRIT and experience the FEEL of being an ADVENTURE RACER before signing up for the Big Race.
NthAdventure invites you to join us to EXPERIENCE the thrill of this amazing sport. From competitive to trial categories, single sport to multiple sport disciplines. We’re here to help you prepare, participate, and perform every time you race.
Our next edition of SPRINT Adventure Racing is here.
You will be Cycling, Trail Running, Hiking & Orienteering, on a non-marked course using google maps to navigate across the finish line collecting all the checkpoints. No prior experience is required. The course has been designed as a first step into the world of Adventure Racing and will give you a true taste of multi-sport, expedition-style racing. From pro athletes to beginners, this race is for all those who want to experience as well as prepare for the next race
What is Adventure Racing: CLICK HERE
Sprint Adventure Racing: CLICK HERE

30 KM Adventure Race - Solo & Open Team of 2

Mountain Biking
Trail running
Hiking
Rope activity 
Orienteering (Google Maps will be provided)
And some surprise elements
Race Split: 30KM Category
Cycling: 80% includes Off-Road, Tarmac, cement road, Mud road, and no road sections
Trail Running & Hiking: 20% includes Trails, farmlands, Tarmac, Cement, and Boulder sections 
Orienteering: 100%
Be Prepared for Abseiling 
Cycling: All Cycles allowed except Electric
Road Cycles are welcome, but we are not responsible for riding in OFF ROADS.

No prior experience is required. The course has been designed as a first step into the world of Orienteering and will give you a true taste of multi-sport, expedition-style racing. From beginners to pro athletes, this race is for all those who want to experience as well as prepare for the next race

name: Breakthrough Run
description:
Breakthrough Run
Resolution started the journey. Commitment kept you showing up. Persistence carried you through. Now it’s time for your breakthrough.
The Breakthrough Run is the fourth and final event in the four-run journey that transforms intentions into habits and habits into lasting change.
Featuring distances up to the Half Marathon (21.1K), this edition allows participants to celebrate how far they have come and achieve the goals they set for themselves at the beginning of the year.
With every step, you complete the journey — and earn the beautiful composite medal that symbolises a year of intention, commitment, persistence, and breakthrough.
Because breakthroughs aren’t found in a single moment, they are built through the choices you make, one step at a time. With every step, you move closer to completing the journey - and to earning the beautiful composite medal that represents your progress through the series.
Series Finisher Reward
As part of the 4-Run Series, participants who complete all four runs will earn a special composite finisher medal - the Soaring Eagle, a symbol of consistency, strength, and commitment across the year.
